rules: Oryx key index N == QMK label kNN == RGB LED index N (verified programmatically for all 52 keys: rgb_matrix.layout[N].matrix == matrix of label kNN).

LAYOUT()/LAYOUT_voyager() argument order is row-interleaved (left row, right row, ...), so layout_macro_arg_index != oryx_index. Oryx's generated keymap.c emits LAYOUT_voyager args in that interleaved order.

Matrix is 12 rows x 7 cols: rows 0-5 = left half (MCU GPIO), rows 6-11 = right half (MCP23018). 84 cells, 52 populated; 32 cells are unused but still occupy 2 bytes each in a VIA dynamic keymap layer (168 bytes per layer).
IS31 pwm_offset is the Cx_y constant from is31fl3731.h; the driver writes PWM register (0x24 + offset) on the frame page (INFERRED from QMK driver convention; not needed by a host app).
electrical.* is derived from matrix.c; right-half mapping: matrix row R <- MCP23018 GPB(11-R), matrix col C <- MCP23018 GPA(6-C).

io_expander.port_b: GPB0-5 column senses (inputs); GPB6 = STATUS_LED_4, GPB7 = STATUS_LED_3 (active LOW)

summary.i2c_bus: I2C1 on PB6 (SCL) / PB7 (SDA), alternate function 4, open-drain (matrix.c 46-50; mcuconf.h STM32_I2C_USE_I2C1)
